messages.subject: Kingsford - Project Onyx board pack
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Nothing to do with Meridian - when you get a moment, can you check the board minutes in the Kingsford Group / Project Onyx folder? Nathan Reilly wants the signed resolutions for the acquisition before the holidays and I think we're still waiting on one director's signature. Drop me a note on where it stands.

Sarah

--
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
